verdict.rationale: Parahelp documents running its Internal Agent without approval prompts from your own tools via the API. It also offers automations triggered by schedules or events such as a GitHub PR merging, and the Customer Agent can take requests through an API instead of a ticketing system. That is genuine headless, non-interactive operation, but depth is unproven: the changelog mention is thin and the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every path. Missing for 10: a CLI or CI runner integration, published API reference/spec, documented auth and exit/status semantics for pipelines, and hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: let the Internal Agent act without waiting for approval, and run it from your own tools via the API.
An automation is an Internal Agent task that runs on a schedule, like every weekday at 9am, or a trigger, like a GitHub PR merging
Customer requests come in through the API instead of a ticketing system. Your Customer Agent handles them with the same configurations, tools, and guardrails
Run your Customer Agent outside a ticketing system, wherever you implement it.
